intro: Choosing a style is one of the most exciting parts of ordering a custom anime portrait—but it can also feel overwhelming. Should your portrait be bold and action-focused, soft and storybook-inspired, highly detailed, or playful and chibi? The best choice depends on more than your favourite series. Your personality, facial features, clothing, intended mood, source photo, and where you plan to display the artwork all matter. This guide explains how to choose an anime portrait style for a personalised commission from a human artist. Anime Cabinet offers 24 anime and cartoon-inspired styles, with every portrait drawn by hand rather than created with an AI filter. The result is an original character inspired by a style’s visual language, not a copyrighted character impersonation. You receive a preview within 72 hours and unlimited free revisions, so you can help shape the final artwork with confidence.
